tspan.tspan: Cheatin'

text.tspan: Once per game, after all the Initiative cards have been revealed, with a smile on their face the Outlaw player may declare that they’re
Cheatin’. They can swap one of the cards in their Hand for one of their Initiative cards on the table. The new card in the hand may either
be played straight away or held for use later in the game.

text.inkscape:label: Above Snakes

tspan.tspan: Above Snakes

text.tspan: Once per turn a character in the Outlaw faction may choose to Duck Back as normal, but after the Duck Back must take a Nerve test. If
passed this does not “burn the activation” but counts as a single action taken. Place a Move marker to indicate this. If the Duck Back is
nullified by the use of the 7 card, the ability is wasted for the turn. Taunts of “lily-liveredness” may need to be endured…
At least half of the faction must be armed with a pistol as their sole ranged weapon. If mounted Characters are permitted in the Scene,
then one mounted Character may be equipped with a lasso. “Above Snakes” and “Cheatin’” may not be used in the same turn; only one
is permitted to be played in a single turn.
